payload.reason: The dataset was collected through a systematic methodology involving contributions from multiple speakers who recorded voice clips from a bank of donated sentences, ensuring diversity in accents and demographics.

claims.text: The dataset was created by contributors recording voice clips from a bank of donated sentences.
Each voice clip was validated by at least two other users to ensure quality.
The dataset includes contributions from over 11,000 speakers with various accents.
Most sentences are covered by multiple speakers, enhancing diversity.
